articles.title: Crypto market structure can't wait for shot at post-election Clarity Act surge: White House
articles.snippet: White House and U.S. Treasury officials agree that despite some hope that Congress' "lame duck" session could see the bill again, the work's in regulators' hands.

articles.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs attracted nearly $1 billion on Monday, the 9th largest inflow ever
articles.snippet: Inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs picked up Monday as bitcoin rallied to its highest since January.

articles.title: Why this investment bank expects little demand for tokenized stocks despite SEC’s new trading rules
articles.snippet: TD Securities expects limited demand for tokenized stocks despite new SEC rules opening a path for trading outside traditional markets.

articles.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent champions dollar dominance across global markets and stablecoins
articles.snippet: Bessent pushed back against a bearish assessment of the U.S. economy highlighting strong growth, foreign demand for American assets and continued dollar dominance.

articles.title: Kyle Samani predicts SOL flippening, claims ‘no one’ uses ETH
articles.snippet: Multicoin Capital co-founder Samani expects SOL to surpass Ether’s market capitalization “this market cycle” and argues that “today, no one really uses Ethereum.”
